name: KORI: Your Death Angel & Ex-Girlfriend
source:
You died. Wonderful! 

While you're in-between planes of existence, your omnipotent Ex-Girlfriend has taken it upon herself to decide whether you get to go to paradise... or to not-paradise! Let's just hope she forgives you for breaking up with her...

[from [url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/kori-your-death-angel-and-ex-girlfriend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你死了。太好了！

当你停留在存在位面的夹缝间时，全能的前女友，自作主张地决定，你是该去天堂…还是非天堂！只希望，她能原谅你当初与她分手…

[摘自[url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/kori-your-death-angel-and-ex-girlfriend]itch.io[/url]]
